hints.title: Matching Positions
hints.text: Find all indices j such that nums[j] == key.

hints.title: Range Coverage
hints.text: Each matching index j marks all indices i where j - k <= i <= j + k as valid.

hints.title: Monotonic Pointer Advancement
hints.text: To avoid duplicates and maintain sorted order, track the next index to add so you never re-examine previously included indices.

hints.title: Linear Interval Covering

complexity.notes: Each index is visited at most once using the nxt pointer.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Comparing all pairs of (i, j) requires O(n^2) operations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Output array stores matching indices; auxiliary memory is O(1).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate delivers single-pass O(n) scan by bounding intervals.
